validation.constraint_violation_scope: leq/equal comparisons only; maximum is a mixed-units diagnostic, not a normalized certificate; do not sum across checks; domain, integrality, finite-value and strict-positive-load checks remain separate rejection checks
validation.cost_scope: initiated whole tasks charged once; transfer on actual delivery; penalties final or expired; partial is not full-day objective

manifest.identity_scope: Exact bytes of enumerated files, including uncommitted changes
manifest.source_relationship: Provided (3) PDF core equations audited against the local source; no claim of byte identity, identical compilation or identity with (3)(1)

source_binding.scope: source hashes recorded only; PDF/source version equivalence is not certified

provenance.git_revision_scope: HEAD only; SHA256 includes uncommitted implementation
provenance.python: 3.11.15 | packaged by Anaconda, Inc. | (main, Jun 11 2026, 15:12:53) [MSC v.1942 64 bit (AMD64)]

direct_endpoint_author_decision.scope: metadata only; does not certify physical routes
direct_endpoint_author_decision.limitation: Does not certify physical hub-to-hub travel or add an unmodeled destination stem

metadata.phase_timing_scope: exclusive wall-time partition within runner API; upstream input loading excluded; window timings are nested diagnostics, not additive to run phases
metadata.vehicle_selector_domain_signature_scope: all tuple keys of x_manual/y_auto/w_direct/empty_vehicles/u_wave/u_direct; excludes cargo, values, bounds, window restrictions and history; equal signatures alone do not certify identical subproblems
metadata.model_scope: adopted V1-F arc-wave + independent empty; excludes S/QVI

mechanism_policy.minimum_load_scope: aggregate cargo per direct arc >= minimum times dispatched vehicles; synthetic policy when positive

metadata.selector_bound_reason: migrated vehicles can serve local waves
metadata.quantity_units: continuous service-equivalents; input contract identifies job/stop proxy and conversion
metadata.cost_units: currency; minutes divided by 60 exactly once
metadata.terminal_default: none; no forced real-T city reset unless explicit full-run target
metadata.completion_policy: new tasks finish within completion window; prior commitments persist
metadata.pruning_evidence_scope: finite checks do not prove general pruning equivalence
metadata.vehicle_usage_scope: dispatched vehicle-task counts, not unique vehicles
